data.markdown:
# Log10x POC, local source (file)

_Pulled 9.1K log lines (2.1 MB) across 16 files. Span: 22 minutes (1,321 s), from the first to the last record timestamp (2026-10-14T20:49:18.587Z to 2026-10-14T21:11:19.670Z; 5,329 of 9,054 sampled records carry one)._

## Sample composition

These files produced the bytes in the sample. **Confirm this looks like your production mix before trusting the projection**, if 70% of your real-prod bytes come from a service that is NOT in this list, the savings projection is meaningless to you. Widen `paths` or raise `max_pods` (the file cap) if anything looks off.

| File | Bytes | Lines | % of sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| `otel-collector` | 1.2 MB | 4.0K | 57% |
| `frontend` | 0.352 MB | 1.3K | 17% |
| `kafka` | 0.214 MB | 997 | 10% |
| `cart` | 80.8 KB | 1.3K | 4% |
| `payment` | 44.3 KB | 134 | 2% |
| `accounting` | 43.3 KB | 134 | 2% |
| `recommendation` | 37.1 KB | 121 | 2% |
| `shipping` | 37 KB | 209 | 2% |
| `ad` | 19.6 KB | 114 | 0.9% |
| `telemetry-docs` | 19.3 KB | 261 | 0.9% |
| _(6 more)_ | 51.3 KB | - | 2% |

## Projected savings at default rates

_Rates: the vendor's list price where it sells logs per GB, and a per-GB default, marked "default rate", where it bills in other units or publishes no per-GB price. Pass `effective_ingest_per_gb` on `log10x_estimate_savings` or `log10x_savings` once your real $/GB is known to convert these projections into a customer-specific quote._

If your full ingest mix matches this sample, ~77% of your byte volume is non-error high-frequency patterns, candidates for compacting, tiering down or offloading, each of which keeps every line.

**Projected daily ingest** (extrapolated from sample): 0.137 GB.

_The daily projection spreads the files' bytes over their span, read from the record timestamps._

_These are list prices and default rates, not predictions of your specific bill: use them to size the order of magnitude, not to negotiate with procurement._

| Log analyzer | Rate | Annual cost | Annual savings |
|---|---|---|---|
| Datadog | $2.50/GB (default rate, a blend of Datadog's two meters, which datadoghq.com/pricing/list gives as $0.10 per GB ingested and $2.50 per million events indexed at 30-day retention, billed annually) | $117 | $90 |
| Splunk | $6.00/GB (default rate, not a Splunk list price) | $280 | $216 |
| CloudWatch Logs | $0.50/GB (ingestion + first-month storage) | $23 | $18 |
| Azure Monitor | $2.30/GB (Analytics tier ingest, list price) | $107 | $83 |
| Sumo Logic | $2.50/GB (default rate, not a Sumo Logic list price) | $117 | $90 |
| Elasticsearch | $1.00/GB (default rate, an estimate of self-managed infrastructure per GB) | $47 | $36 |
| Coralogix | $1.15/GB (Frequent Search (High) priority, list price) | $54 | $41 |
| Elastic Cloud Serverless | $0.07/GB (Logs Essentials ingest floor; retention billed separately) | $3.3 | $2.5 |
| OpenSearch | $0.10/GB (self-hosted compute baseline (no canonical list rate)) | $4.7 | $3.6 |

## Top patterns in the sample

| # | Identity | Events | % | Bytes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Traces {"resource": {"…` | 1.1K | 14% | 0.342 MB |
| 2 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Metrics {"resource": {…` | 981 | 12% | 0.331 MB |
| 3 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Logs {"resource": {"se…` | 821 | 10% | 0.256 MB |
| 4 | `{"level":$,"time":$(+%s),"pid":$,"hostname":"$","trace_id":…` | 504 | 6% | 0.146 MB |
| 5 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Logs {"resource": {"se…` | 497 | 6% | 0.155 MB |
| 6 | `info: cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore[$] GetCartAsync called…` | 265 | 3% | 32.3 KB |
| 7 | `JB:WQS#/j&` | 261 | 3% | 19.3 KB |
| 8 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS) $ [$] FATAL: role "root" does no…` | 257 | 3% | 17.7 KB |
| 9 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Traces {"resource": {"…` | 219 | 3% | 68.1 KB |
| 10 | `{"level":$,"time":$(+%s),"pid":$,"hostname":"$","trace_id":…` | 198 | 2% | 54.5 KB |

_For native stack exclusion configs, paste-ready Receiver YAML, and the full 9-section report, run `log10x_poc_from_siem` once you have credentials available._

## Notes
- wrapped-JSON normalization applied: 9054 of 9054 lines decoded; analysed bytes count the unwrapped payload, raw file size is 3911217 bytes.

_This POC read local files on a machine with network access. The same POC runs with no network at all. To run it offline, see `actions[]` for `log10x_emit_sample_plan`, or the [offline POC guide](https://github.com/log-10x/log10x-mcp/blob/main/docs/fenced-poc.md)._

**Fleet default.** Any service not listed: a statement above 2,878 lines a day goes to the offload bucket. Up to 1,800 lines a day of every statement always reach Standard on each node. To install it, call `log10x_advise_install` with the `fleet_default` from this result and `log_destination: "datadog"`.
